button.name: action_save_version
button.invisible: not contract_terms_summary or state not in ('draft','verified','contract_drafted','legal_review','changes_requested')

button.name: action_restart_signing
button.confirm: This will cancel the current signature request and restart the signing process. Continue?

button.name: action_send_cover_letter
button.string: Send Contract Cover Letter to HOD

button.name: action_resend_cover_letter
button.string: Resend Contract Cover Letter to HOD
button.invisible: state not in ('cover_letter_sent', 'cover_letter_rejected') or memo_id == False

button.name: action_sign_line
button.invisible: is_service_provider or sign_initials != False or user_id == False

button.name: action_revert_version
button.confirm: Are you sure you want to revert contract terms to this version? This will overwrite the current draft terms.

field.name: help
field.p: Create a new contract to begin the procurement contract management process.
